title: Report Spam Message
summary: Given an array of strings message and an array of strings bannedWords, determine if message contains at least two words that exactly match any word in bannedWords.
statement: Given an array of strings message and an array of strings bannedWords, determine if message contains at least two words that exactly match any word in bannedWords. Return true if message is spam, otherwise return false.
constraints: message and bannedWords contain lowercase words.
A message is spam when at least two message positions exactly match any banned word.
Repeated matching message words count at each occurrence.
hints: Membership lookup should be constant-time because every message word is checked.
Convert banned words to a set and count matching message positions.
Return whether the count reaches two.
Iterating message positions naturally counts repeated occurrences as required.
editorial: Iterating message positions naturally counts repeated occurrences as required.

tests.explanation: Two message positions match banned words, so the message is spam.
Only programming matches, so the message is not spam.
